text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The morning of my day off, I spot Daiwa Scarlet standing in front of the pharmacy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Gah! Trainer?! Stop right there! Don't come near me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Urgh… Well… The thing is… I've got a pimple on my forehead.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And after I made sure to come here bright and early so I wouldn't run into anyone I knew… Just my luck.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Anyway, there you have it. Bye!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet seems to be suffering from skin problems…
